cards.title: Build Phase
items: next build exports statically to web/out/ so basePath /web matches the backend mount contract
make web-build copies output to internal/web/dist and is a prerequisite of build-server
find -exec gzip -9 precompresses each file; Maple Mono CN is hosted on Cloudflare R2 and stays out of the bundle and Go binary

cards.title: Embed & Ship
items: //go:embed all:dist delivers the frontend in one binary; the final image is distroless nonroot
readStatic prefers .gz and falls back to the original file, preventing a site-wide failure from missing gzip
Accept-Encoding is parsed explicitly, ignoring q=0: gzip is sent directly, otherwise decompression happens on demand

cards.title: Fallback & CI
items: Missing static assets return 404 so HTML is never cached as JS/CSS
Other page paths return index.html; /web and /web/ serve the home page directly without a 301
The CI path filter includes web/**; web/out is cached by content hash, then gzipped, compiled and packaged
